units.rationale: Rubric declares two criteria quantified over ENCHRON_ASSERTION payload produced by structural-test@2 playback-core-network-resilience (HTTPMediaSourceRangeTests.swift:536-538). The payload carries consumerWaiting false, fixtureDigest sha256:, fixtureIdentity av1-flac-avsync-10s.mkv, bytesAfterOpen/Prefetch and forwardBufferedBytes/forwardByteLimit (128*1024), so forwardBufferedBytes reaching forwardByteLimit is decidable. Negative controls correctly reject command exit code without payload, missing digest/fields as Indeterminate, and unbounded read or consumer-waiting trace as Violated, so no unnamed threshold remains.

Rubric binds interaction.trace from diagnostics.surface-probe@1 (regression_operation_adapter.py:5194) which inlines pre-fault playback.probe fields (session, sourceIdentity, contentRevision, topologyDigest via playback_topology_digest at line 925) and post-recovery expectationObservation (demuxReconnects, lifecycle Playing, positionMillis 5000->8000). Criterion 2 keeps same session/streamEpoch and increasing videoSamples, both published on PlayerUI-playback-state at Apps/Enchron/MainView.swift:799-800 (streamEpoch, videoSamples). Negative controls distinguish controller-only success from delivery and forbid invented sequence numbers.

Rubric correctly separates control-plane vs playback-state evidence channels: criterion 2 documents that projection, stereoLayout and formatProvenance are assembled into PlayerUI-window-control-plane alone (MainView.swift:752,777,754) while playback-state string (1031-1154) republishes only horizontalFieldOfViewDegrees at 1098. Therefore relatedResults[0] before and [1] Flat override are compared against bound control-plane fields, not playback probe. Criterion 1 checks format.apply before/after provenance userOverride with unchanged source declaration, and negative controls forbid unsignalled 360.mp4 oracle.

Rubric registers two cases with distinct media identities: panoramic-to-portal uses 180_3D.mp4 (internal-spatial-180-sbs-v1, registry 8192x4096) and flat-to-window uses sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 (registry 1280x720). Criterion 2 records arm→format apply→terminal settlement→fetch→disarm trace and expects equirectangular180/portal with user projection/packing/revision vs Flat/window flat/mono, each decidable from bound transition.trace and window.control-plane fields. Negative controls forbid reused identity, stale revision or disarm-before-fetch.

Rubric requires every surface-tapping activation to declare dismissControls true so the surface toggle (PlaybackSessionModel.swift:579-589 showControls.toggle) raises chrome; presentation fixtures leave auto-hide at 300s, so shown chrome persists. Window case validates one tapSequence over PlayerUI-window-playback-surface then PlayerUI-TopAction-videoFormat with alsoInspected array reporting four PlayerUI-VideoFormat rows exists=false after surface and true after videoFormat, proving editor inside one command. Portal case binds its own videoFormat activation plus inlined Playback surface label responses, because portal chrome lives outside main-window tree (product.md:21) and only tap return evidence is admissible.

Rubric registers four cases: source-flat sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4->Flat/window, source-panorama internal-apple-apmp-180-v1 (registry embeddedProjectionSignaling true, mapped to equirectangular180 by MediaFormatInterpreter.swift:163-168)->portal, persisted-flat and persisted-panorama with userOverride. Criterion 2 for persisted cases inlines relatedResults[0] sourceIdentity and [1] contentRevision from the persist attempt after format.apply@2 before relaunch, each sha256: storage key not none, and requires bound open equality character-for-character, so the comparison has both operands in the bound artifact and satisfies oracle-protocol case conjunction.

Rubric requires spatial controls to expose PlayerPanel-button-exit-spatial after toggleControls and delivery starts panorama-to-portal transition (product-side line recorded by SpatialPlatformEffectExecutor). Criterion 2 requires final snapshot presentation=portal attached=portal transition=none pendingSpatialEffect=none and abs(fields.position-spatialState.fields.position) <=5 seconds under HC-021 5-second observed-position bound after exact pre-exit target binding from PlayerUI-spatial-state, whose fields are published at ImmersivePlaybackControlsAttachmentView.swift:243. Negative controls forbid controller-only success, missing sequence numbers, or immersive attachment left active.

Rubric binds one portal tapSequence return whose alsoInspected JSON array records after label:Playback surface that PlayerUI-TopAction-resumePanorama and PlayerUI-TopAction-videoFormat are exists-enabled-hittable in same command, per product.md:21 portal chrome outside main-window tree. Producer declares dismissControls true so label:Playback surface showControls.toggle raises chrome; without it the surface would hide siblings. Criterion 2 checks tappedIdentifiers contains only resumePanorama while videoFormat appears only in alsoInspected, proving coexistence without sibling delivery, and negative controls forbid snapshot after panorama settlement (product.md:17 removes portal chrome).

Rubric requires preActionMatchedElement recorded by the entry route for identifier PlayerUI-TopAction-resumePanorama with label Enter Panorama isEnabled/isHittable true, with null/other identifier as Indeterminate because portal chrome lives outside main-window tree (product.md:21) so summon hierarchy not substitute. Criterion 2 requires application-side delivery followed by presentation request, attachment ownership transfer and panorama settlement for same revision, and negative controls forbid automatic entry without explicit action or preActionMatchedElement copied from summon tap or later snapshot.

Rubric quantifies over spatialTap events in bound interaction.trace: show case exactly one accepted spatialTap ending controlsVisible=true, hide case two ordered accepted spatialTaps ending false, per Device Hub lane. Criterion 2 requires every accepted event names active presentation real input entity, precedes toggle source=spatialTap, and for show completes placement before enablement with no Window Scene input event, all fields emitted by SurfaceInputProbes at MainView.swift and ImmersiveSpaceView.swift. Negative controls correctly reject allowSmall, small/unprepared Device Hub window, diagnostic probe entity, or wrong parity.

Rubric opens WebDAV sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv and requires relatedResults[1] and [3] as two succeeded tapSequence responses each reporting one command (controls via toggleControls, so no step toggles chrome). Criterion 2 checks alsoInspected afterStep ordering: first PlayerUI-TopAction-more→PlayerUI-menu-audio→PlayerUI-menu-audio-2, second PlayerUI-TopAction-more→PlayerUI-menu-subtitles→label:sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.zh-CN.srt, proving sidecar activation inside same command. Criterion 3 preserves media identity and audio/subtitle track identities after seek/docked/portal/format mutation, with pure spatial transition also preserving media session identity.

Rubric requires armed one-shot settlement-timeout fault (transition-trace.arm@1 fault=settlement-timeout) consumed after real Enter Panorama tap, with spatial-surface-settlement-failed path returning presentation/attachment/renderer consumer to Portal. Criterion 2 terminal state has transition none, pendingSpatialEffect none, lifecycle Playing, surfaceAttachmentFailed visible, presentationRolledBack recorded, one live zero retiring technical sessions and present Portal renderer entity, all fields published by PlaybackSessionModel and SpatialPlatformEffectExecutor and observed via transition.trace and control-plane. Negative controls forbid controller-only success, unconsumed fault or generic presentationConversionFailed.
